observationPeriod.calendarDateNote: Source application dates are floating calendar dates. No UTC timezone is assigned to these date-only values.

scope.label: Development permit applications in the past 12 months
scope.caveat: Applications include signs, renovations and changes of use as well as new buildings. An application or approval does not establish that construction has started or will be completed.
scope.statusNote: Statuses are the current source values at retrieval, not their status on the application date. Cancelled and inactive applications are retained and can be filtered.
scope.geography: Community code assigned by the source. Some permits can refer to multiple locations; the displayed marker is the source representative point.
scope.coverage: Four core communities only: HIL, SSD, BRD and BLN. Data is complete for the stated query (178 records; count endpoint reconciled).
scope.monthlyChartNote: September 2025 and September 2026 are partial months in this rolling 365-day query.
